structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), number 5139282. The page says I'd end up with about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. That's for 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 a month at 7%; I couldn't set my own amount.

stuck.where: Screen 1, second box 'הזוג הבא בתור' with '‎-43 ₪'
stuck.why: For a second I thought the minus meant losing money. Then I decided it just means 43 less than my pick.
I wanted to put in 30,000 but couldn't, so every number I saw is for the page's 10,000.
I don't know this name. I only went with it because the page marked it 'הבחירה' and its fees showed 0%.

stuck.where: Screens 3-4, the long list of funds and accounts
stuck.why: Too many options that look alike, all covered in coloured tags. Without the star I'd have done nothing today.

findings.what: Too many accounts and funds that look alike, covered in coloured tags. Without the star I wouldn't have chosen anything.
The big number is calculated for the example amounts, not for my money.
Minus signs in red/purple: you can't tell if they mean a loss or just 'less than my pick'.
Lots of jargon tags I don't understand (דמי משמרת, נאמן, עסקת החלף, 4D)
The recommended fund comes from a company I've never heard of, and the page doesn't say why it's safe.
Fees shown as percentages next to shekels, so it's unclear what 1,057 ₪ is
A range like 'בין +2,212 ל-‎-23,766' is scary and unexplained
